quotaStorage.lifetimeCounters: Successful commits only, including successful command no-ops
quotaStorage.negativePolicy: Shared bounded FIFO; atomic adapter-record and receipt eviction
quotaStorage.successRetry: Exact until room expiry, including at positive storage ceilings
quotaStorage.rejectionRetry: Exact while cached; evicted rejected keys/IDs may be re-evaluated

limitations: Local workerd evidence does not establish deployed latency, quotas or multi-room throughput.
Native edge rate bindings are permissive and location-local; binding thresholds must track the centralized policy.
Public retry guarantees end at room expiry; the original minimal retired marker remains bounded.
Production origins and rate-binding setup are deferred with deployment; no UI/realtime integration is included.
